title: Women in 1950s Fashion at Church, B&W Snapshot 1950
description: A black and white 1950 snapshot capturing two well-dressed women outside an arched church entrance, likely attending a wedding or formal event. The woman on the right wears a distinctive feathery hat, tweed coat, and corsage, while her companion wears vintage eyeglasses and a heavy coat. A man wearing a suit with a boutonniere stands beside them. Dated October 28, 1950 on the back.
